description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductImageGet' for retrieving product images within a CMS module, specifying methods for accessing images by product details and sizes.

classes.name: ProductImageGet
classes.description: A Java interface for accessing product images, extending ImageGet and providing methods to retrieve images by product code, image name, size, and product object.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on merchant store code, product code, and image name.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image with specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on a ProductImage object.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a product.
